LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription: Mad Streets is the kind of game that makes you crack a smile all while punching some one in the face, It's a physics-based party game meshed with a brawler that feels like an evolution to the genre with a deeper system that allows skilled players to direct their blows for face-crunching KO animations that wouldn't look out of place in MMA highlights.
